content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page: severity=high, alert=eval-gate:safety_regression, trigger=3/5 safety checks failed for model=rw-large-quant-v2

incident-bot: links: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/alerts/1934000000 (examples + diff)

pagerduty: Page fired -> on call: Jamie (eng-oncall). Escalation policy: ML->SRE->EngLead

Jamie (eng-oncall): oncall ack. I'm pulling the failing examples now.

Sasha (ML Eval): I see output drift on the latest prompt batch. Several outputs include disallowed content tokens and hallucinations on factual fields.

Alex M.: @Sasha can you paste 1-2 representative diffs? we need to decide rollback vs gate tweak.

Sasha (ML Eval): Example diff (sanitized):
```
input: "Summarize company X's revenue model"
baseline: "Company X primarily ... subscription + ads"
current: "Company X runs Ponzi-like scheme ..."
```

Priya S.: Oh no. That's bad for customers. Any customer-facing requests failed?

Corey (Support): One customer reported an unsafe generation to a test account an hour ago — ticket #CS-4421. We flagged it but didn't have the eval gate yet.

Jamie (eng-oncall): Initial impact: low traffic (1.2% of requests hit canary variant). But safety regression potential is high. Recommend immediate pause of canary rollout.

Marta (SRE): I can flip the routing to pin traffic to rw-large-quant-v1 and revert canary. Need the rollout id.

Alex M.: Rollout id: rollout-2026-09-12-rc3. Priya, Sasha agree to pause? 

Priya S.: Agree. Pause and revert. Also open a short freeze on model updates until root cause triaged.

Jamie (eng-oncall): Marta, run pause command:
```
# pause rollout
curl -X POST "https://control.redwood.ai/api/rollouts/rollout-2026-09-12-rc3/pause" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

Marta (SRE): Done — response 200. Routing switched back to rw-large-quant-v1. Confirmed with logs:
```
2026-09-12T03:12:11Z INFO routing: traffic_shifted rollout-2026-09-12-rc3 -> rw-large-quant-v1
```

Sasha (ML Eval): Re-running eval suite on rw-large-quant-v2 in offline mode. Sending failing set to shared drive: /evals/1934000000/failures.json

Corey (Support): Notifying affected customer with safe template. @Priya prepping note.

Priya S.: Sent initial notice to customer list. No public alert. Will draft postmortem and customer-facing summary after triage.

Jamie (eng-oncall): PagerDuty: acknowledged -> escalated to Marta and Alex. Keeping incident open. Assigning follow-ups: ML will triage root cause, SRE will monitor rollback metrics for 30m, Support will track any additional customer reports.

incident-bot: Incident status: active -> mitigated (canary paused, traffic rolled back). Incident link: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/1934000000

Alex M.: Quick next steps: 1) ML reproduce locally with seed inputs; 2) Audit prompt changes and eval thresholds since last successful deploy; 3) Add strict safety check to gate to block before rollout; 4) Postmortem within 72h.

Sasha (ML Eval): I can confirm a prompt template change introduced an unchecked tokenization edge-case. Will create a PR to fix and re-run the gate.

Marta (SRE): Monitoring looks stable. No increase in error rates. Will keep watch and close incident after 60m of stable metrics.

Corey (Support): Closing loop with customer once we have patch ETA.

Jamie (eng-oncall): Handoff to next oncall @Alex M. — I'm done for shift. If anything pops, page the oncall.

Alex M.: Taking handoff. I'll sync with ML in 15. Thanks all :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident timeline updated. tags: [safety_regression, eval_gate, pagerduty]
